personalReminder.title: Hello,
personalReminder.additionalMessage:
Meeting Point: Atrium, Beneath the Sauropods 🦕✨

A few things to keep in mind:

* The session is suitable for all levels.
* Please bring your own yoga mat.
* You’ll need a valid Natural History Museum Abu Dhabi admission ticket for {{date}}. We recommend purchasing it in advance and having it ready at check-in.
* Please arrive 10–15 minutes early so you have time to settle in before we begin.

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us on 058 279 1010.

We’re looking forward to sharing this beautiful morning practice with you, surrounded by the wonders of our natural world. 🌿🧘‍♀️🦕🤍
